elements.title: PYTHON CODE
elements.details: Screenshot of Python code to import libraries, load MNIST dataset, split into training and testing sets, and standardize features using StandardScaler. Code includes import tensorflow as tf, fetch_openml, train_test_split, StandardScaler, and commands to load mnist_784 dataset, split 80/20, and scale features.
elements.summary: This code snippet demonstrates how to set up data preprocessing steps in Python for training a neural network on the MNIST handwritten digits dataset using TensorFlow and scikit-learn.
